column.name: parameter_sql
column.value: SELECT id, code_value FROM m_code_value WHERE code_id = (SELECT id FROM m_code WHERE code_name = 'Languages')

update.column: SELECT cl.id AS `id`, cl.firstname AS `firstName`, cl.middlename AS `middleName`, cl.lastname AS `lastName`, cl.display_name AS `fullName`, cl.mobile_no AS `mobileNo`, l.principal_amount AS `loanAmount`, mo.id AS `officeNumber`, (IFNULL(l.principal_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(l.interest_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(l.fee_charges_outstanding_derived, 0) + IFNULL(l.penalty_charges_outstanding_derived, 0)) AS `loanOutstanding`, l.principal_disbursed_derived AS `loanDisbursed`, ls.duedate AS `paymentDueDate`, ( IFNULL(SUM(ls.principal_amount), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.principal_writtenoff_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.principal_completed_derived ), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(ls.interest_amount), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.interest_writtenoff_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.interest_waived_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.interest_completed_derived ), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(ls.fee_charges_amount), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.fee_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.fee_charges_waived_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.fee_charges_completed_derived ), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_amount), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_writtenoff_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_waived_derived), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(ls.penalty_charges_completed_derived ), 0) ) AS `totalDue`, laa.total_overdue_derived AS `totalOverdue`, l.account_no AS `loanAccountId`, cv.code_value as `Language` FROM m_office mo JOIN m_office ounder ON ounder.hierarchy LIKE CONCAT(mo.hierarchy, '%') LEFT JOIN m_client cl ON cl.office_id=ounder.id LEFT JOIN m_loan l ON l.client_id=cl.id AND l.loan_status_id=300 LEFT JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = l.product_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_repayment_schedule ls ON l.id = ls.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_loan_arrears_aging laa ON laa.loan_id = l.id LEFT JOIN `Preferred Language` pl On pl.client_id = cl.id LEFT JOIN m_code_value cv ON cv.id = pl.`Languages_cd_First Language` WHERE mo.id = ${officeId} AND (IFNULL(l.loan_officer_id, -10) = ${loanOfficerId} OR -1 = ${loanOfficerId}) AND (DATEDIFF(ls.duedate, CURDATE()) = ${fromX}) AND (${isIslamic} = -1 OR lp.is_islamic = ${isIslamic}) AND (${language} = -1 OR cv.id = ${language}) GROUP BY cl.id, cl.firstname, cl.middlename, cl.lastname, cl.display_name, cl.mobile_no, l.principal_amount, mo.id, l.principal_disbursed_derived, ls.duedate, laa.total_overdue_derived, l.account_no, l.id, lp.is_islamic ORDER BY ounder.id, ls.duedate, l.account_no
